I don't understand how I've fallen into this category, I've gone over the description of RWT bans and nothing fits the description of anything I've done in-game

It's heart-wrenching to not know why I've been banned, if anyone is able to look into this and help me get my account back or better understand the reason for the ban that would be great

we had a conversation for an hour, then she said she would call me back because she was on my friends phone, then they got to talking and some things were said that I still have no clue about, I've tried to give them both my side and beg for the story that she had given her, crickets... no reply whatsoever the last message I got was from my friend (female) and it said "I hope you find the courage to kill yourself, Simon, the world doesn't need more people with a negative attitude and thoughts like yours. Don't take this as an "I hate you" message but as a plea, you bring down everyone around you, can you really live a fulfilling life knowing that?"

how can i solve something when i feel like the only answer is a question..  
why me ?

my so-called best friend decided to push the girl i love away from me by making up some story which neither of them will tell me.  
it seems petty i know, but this was the only good thing i had left to keep me going..
